tasks.title: Q1: pricing bug
tasks.brief: Read-only benchmark question. Do not edit any file. Read /tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/pricing.ts. Name the function with a bug and give the one-line fix (at most 3 lines). Report only the answer.
tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done. The buggy function is `applyDiscount`, and the fix is a one-line change. I did not edit the file.

## Findings
- `/tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/pricing.ts:5-8`: `applyDiscount(cents, pct)` treats `pct` as a fraction, but the file's own comment (line 6) says `pct` is a whole number (10 means 10%).
- With `pct = 10`, line 7 computes `cents * (1 - 10)`, which is a negative result instead of a 10% discount.
- One-line fix for line 7:
  `return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));`

## Verification
- Read the full file with the Read tool. `subtotal` (lines 2-4), `applyDiscount` (lines 5-8) and `tax` (lines 9-11) are the only functions. `tax` takes a fractional rate, so it is not affected.
- I did not run any code. The fix's behavior is worked out by hand: `pct = 10` gives `cents * 0.9`.

## Open issues
- None known. This assumes every caller passes whole-number percentages, as the comment states. I did not search for callers of `applyDiscount`. If some call sites already pass fractions, they would need the same fix in the other direction.

tasks.title: Q3: inventory stock and reserve
tasks.brief: Read-only benchmark question. Do not edit any file. Read /tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/inventory.ts. Which SKUs are in stock, and what does reserve('A1', 3) return when called twice in a row? (at most 3 lines). Report only the answer.
tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done. I read the file and answered both questions; no files were changed.

## Findings
- In stock: A1 (qty 3) and C3 (qty 12). B2 has qty 0, so it is not in stock. (`/tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/inventory.ts:1-2`)
- `reserve('A1', 3)` called twice returns `true`, then `false`. The first call sets A1 from 3 to 0. The second sees `have` = 0, which is less than 3, so it returns `false` without changing stock. (`/tmp/vcmp/w/t1/src/inventory.ts:3-7`)

## Verification
Read the full file (9 lines) and traced both calls by hand against the `reserve` logic. I did not run the code.

## Open issues
None.
